description: Arm a new automated drop watch, Lightning Lane auto-booker, or dining reservation stakeout in Disney Edge.

autoBook.description: For LIGHTNING_DROP: whether to auto-select and auto-book when slot drops (requires SKIPPER_PASS).

dineDate.description: For DINING_ADR: date of reservation in YYYY-MM-DD format.

entityName.description: Name of the ride or restaurant (e.g. "Cosmic Rewind", "Test Track", "Space 220", "TRON", "Seven Dwarfs Mine Train").

maxWait.description: For STANDBY_UNDER or DINING_WALKUP: target maximum wait time in minutes.

phone.description: Optional E.164 phone number of the customer account.

watchType.description: Type of alert: LIGHTNING_DROP (sniping drop replenishments), STANDBY_UNDER (wait drops below X mins), RIDE_REOPENS (alert when ride restarts), DINING_ADR (reservation date stakeout), DINING_WALKUP (walk-up table wait).

name: create_watch_alert
